lede: GMA Automotive Services is a car workshop in Woodlands Avenue 10 (Woodlands Industrial Xchange). Its own website lists spray painting, panel beating, insurance claims and body kits and widebody.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention body kit and scratch repairs, minor paint touch-ups finished in about a day and a half, honest advice and no hard selling.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, gmaautomotiveservices.com.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
good_to_know: Enquiries by WhatsApp, according to its website
